Common Symptoms Vibration at idle or while driving Rough running Increased noise Likely Causes Engine mounts Misfires or faulty injectors Flywheel or clutch issues Typical Cost Range £150 - £600 (common issues) £600 - £2,000 (major repairs) £2,000+ (engine replacement) Urgency Low: Minor vibration Moderate: Noticeable vibration High: Severe vibration Stop driving: Risk of major damage DIAGNOSIS & SYMPTOMS Vibration at Idle Engine mounts are rubber and hydraulic components that isolate engine vibration from the chassis. When they wear, crack, or collapse, the engine transmits vibration directly to the body - felt most strongly at idle. Vibration pattern: Steering wheel or seat vibration when stationary. Vibration reduces or disappears when driving. May also hear a clunk when accelerating or decelerating as the engine rocks on broken mounts. Vehicle Type Parts Cost (per mount) Labour Hours Total Cost (one mount) Total Cost (full set) Small car (Fiesta, Corsa, Clio) £30 - £100 1.5 - 2.5 hrs £100 - £250 £150 - £400 Family car (Focus, Astra, Golf) £40 - £150 2 - 3 hrs £150 - £350 £200 - £500 Executive / SUV (BMW 3 Series, Q5, X3) £60 - £250 2.5 - 4 hrs £200 - £500 £300 - £700 Premium / Large SUV (Range Rover, X5, Q7) £80 - £350 3 - 5 hrs £300 - £650 £450 - £900 Specialist rule of thumb: "If you feel vibration at idle but the engine runs smoothly when revved in neutral, it's almost always engine mounts. A £200-£500 fix. Don't let anyone sell you spark plugs or injectors for idle vibration." Need Professional Diagnosis? Get a quote from our network of trusted UK specialists. Vehicle Make / Model Get Instant Quote DIAGNOSIS & SYMPTOMS Vibration Under Acceleration One or more cylinders aren't firing correctly. The engine runs unevenly, producing a shaking or jerking sensation - most noticeable under load (acceleration, uphill). Vibration pattern: Engine shakes under acceleration, especially between 1,500-3,000 RPM. May be smooth at idle. Often accompanied by loss of power, poor fuel economy, and potentially a flashing engine management light. Cause Repair Cost Most Common On Spark plugs (full set) £50 - £150 All petrol engines >60k miles Ignition coil (one) £70 - £220 Ford EcoBoost, VW TSI, BMW N-series Fuel injector (one - petrol/diesel) £120 - £900 Direct injection petrol, all diesels Vacuum / air leak £50 - £300 All engines Low compression (valves, rings) £800 - £3,500+ High-mileage engines Diagnostic signs: • Vibration under acceleration, smooth at idle • Loss of power, especially uphill • Poor fuel economy • Engine management light (steady or flashing) Specialist rule of thumb (petrol): "On a petrol engine with vibration under acceleration, swap the ignition coil with another cylinder. If the vibration moves, it's a £70-£220 coil. If it doesn't move, check spark plugs first - a full set is £50-£150." Vibration Getting Worse? Severe vibration can lead to expensive damage. Get expert advice before it's too late. Speak to a Specialist DIAGNOSIS & GEARBOX Vibration on Clutch Engagement The dual-mass flywheel absorbs torsional vibration from the engine. When its internal springs or bearings fail, it produces vibration specifically when engaging the clutch or during gear changes. Vibration pattern: Vibration or judder when pulling away from a stop. Rattle or knocking noise at idle that disappears when the clutch pedal is pressed. Vehicle Type DMF Parts Cost Clutch Kit (recommended) Total Cost (DMF + clutch) Small car (Fiesta, Corsa) £300 - £500 £100 - £200 £500 - £900 Family car (Focus, Golf) £400 - £700 £150 - £300 £650 - £1,200 Executive / SUV (BMW 3 Series, A4) £500 - £900 £200 - £400 £800 - £1,500 Premium / Large SUV (Range Rover, X5) £600 - £1,200 £300 - £600 £1,000 - £2,000 Specialist rule of thumb: "If you hear a rattle at idle that goes away when you press the clutch, it's almost always the dual-mass flywheel. Replace the clutch at the same time - the gearbox is already off, and you'll pay the same labour." Clutch or Gearbox Issues? Compare quotes from vetted specialists and save on repair costs. Get a Quote SAFETY INFORMATION Stop Driving Immediately In some situations, engine vibration can indicate a serious problem. Stop driving immediately if you notice any of the following symptoms. Do Not Continue Driving If You Experience: Severe or violent vibration Loss of power Knocking or banging noises Dashboard warning lights Smoke, overheating or burning smells 🚨 Critical warning - internal imbalance: If the whole car shakes violently and the vibration increases with engine RPM, stop driving immediately. This indicates a broken crankshaft, connecting rod failure, or a dropped valve. Continued driving will cause complete engine destruction (£2,500-£6,500+). 🚨 Flashing EML + vibration: If your engine management light is flashing while the engine vibrates, unburnt fuel is destroying your catalytic converter (petrol) or DPF (diesel). Stop driving immediately - repair cost escalates from £60-£800 to £1,000-£2,500. COMMON ENGINE TYPES Engines with Known Vibration Issues Some engines are more prone to vibration issues. Here are examples commonly reported by UK owners. Engine Common Issue Severity BMW N47 (2.0 Diesel) Timing chain wear High Ford EcoBoost (1.0 / 1.5) Engine mount wear Moderate VAG 2.0 TDI DMF and EGR issues Moderate Mercedes OM651 Engine mount & injector issues Moderate Jaguar Land Rover 2.0 Ingenium Timing chain & mounting High Market context - Land Rover 306DT crankshaft failure: Based on KNOWN FAILURE PATTERNS, the Land Rover 306DT (SDV6/TDV6 3.0) generated 980 quote requests in 2025 [EM-VERIFIED] and is known for catastrophic crankshaft bearing failure between 80,000-140,000 miles. Cold-start knock is the early warning. DIAGNOSTIC PROCESS Finding the Cause A systematic approach helps identify the real cause of engine vibration. 1 Check for fault codes Scan with an OBD2 reader for pending or active trouble codes. 2 Visual inspection Inspect hoses, mounts, wiring and visible mechanical components. 3 Test engine mounts Check for collapsed rubber, excessive movement or hydraulic leakage. 4 Check fuel & ignition Examine spark plugs, coil packs, and injector spray balances. 5 Inspect clutch & drivetrain Check DMF play, drive shafts, universal joints, and gearbox bushes. Diagnostic rule: "Never replace engine mounts based on vibration alone. A misfire can feel like a shaky engine mount at idle. Always do an OBD2 scan first - it's £50-£120 and will tell you if there's a misfire code before you spend £150-£500 on mounts that won't fix the problem." REPAIR OR REPLACE? Vehicle Value Threshold Your vehicle's value can help determine whether to repair or replace major components. Vehicle Value Recommendation Under £2,000 Consider lower-cost repairs only £2,000 - £5,000 Compare repair vs replacement costs £5,000 - £10,000 Repair is usually worthwhile Over £10,000 Repair recommended (maintain value) For minor vibration causes (mounts, misfire, DMF): Repair is almost always economical regardless of vehicle value, as costs range from £150-£1,500. DIAGNOSE QUICKLY TO ACT Urgency Matrix Use this matrix to understand how quickly you should take action based on the symptoms. Symptom Likelihood Urgency Recommended Action Slight vibration at idle High Low Monitor and inspect Noticeable vibration while driving High Moderate Book diagnostic check Severe vibration Moderate High Stop driving and get inspected Vibration with warning light Moderate High Stop driving immediately REPAIR OR REPLACE GUIDES Common Questions Answered Frequently asked questions about engine vibration diagnosis, pricing, and vehicle safety. What causes engine vibration? + The most common cause is worn engine mounts (£150-£500). A misfire can also cause idle vibration - an OBD2 scan (£50-£120) will confirm which. Is engine vibration always serious? + Not always. Worn engine mounts create uncomfortable vibrations in the cabin but rarely cause immediate catastrophic failure. However, vibration accompanied by a flashing engine management light or severe knocking indicates major internal failure and requires immediate stoppage. How much does it cost to fix engine vibration? + Spark plugs: £50-£150. Ignition coil: £70-£220. Fuel injector: £120-£900. Dual-mass flywheel (DMF): £500-£1,500. Diagnostic first (£50-£120) - don't guess. Can I still drive with engine vibration? + Vibration at idle (mounts) - yes, but book diagnostic. Vibration under acceleration with flashing EML - no, stop immediately. Constant heavy vibration that worsens with revs - no, stop immediately - internal engine failure. Which engines are most prone to vibration? + Based on KNOWN FAILURE PATTERNS, the Land Rover 306DT (SDV6/TDV6) - 980 quote requests [EM-VERIFIED] - is known for crankshaft bearing failure. BMW N47 (timing chain/injectors) and Mercedes OM651 (injector seals) are also commonly observed. Should I repair or replace the engine? + If vibration is caused by mounts, misfires, or flywheels, repair is almost always the right financial choice (£150-£1,500). If internal engine failure (crankshaft or conrod) has occurred, evaluate vehicle value: under £4,000 often warrants replacement or scrapping, whereas vehicles over £8,000 justify a reconditioned engine replacement.
